body.input: of existentialism is, it's an idea

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: that you find expressed in different ways

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: in a bunch of these people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: One of the ways that it's expressed is that Sartre will say

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: that existentialism is the view that there is no God

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: and at least his form of existentialism,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: he calls it atheistic existentialism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: There is no God.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And since there's no God,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: there must be some other being around

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: who does something like what God does.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Otherwise there wouldn't be any possibility

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: for significance in a life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And that being is us and the feature of us,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: according to Sartre and the other existentialists,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: that puts us in the position to be able to play that role

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: is that we're the beings for whom, as Sartre says it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: existence precedes essence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: That's the catchphrase for existentialism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And then you have to try to figure out what it means.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: What does existence, what does presence

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: and what does precedes mean?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Yeah, exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: What is existence?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: What is essence and what is precedes?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And in fact, precedes is Sartre's way of talking about it

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: and other people will talk about it differently.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: But here's the way Sartre thinks about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: This is not, I think, the most interesting way

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: to think about it, but it gets you started.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Sartre says there's nothing true about what it is to be you

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: until you start existing and still you start living.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And for Sartre, the core feature of what it is

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: to be existing the way we do is to be making decisions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: to be making choices in your life,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: to be sort of taking a stand on what it is to be you

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: by deciding to do this or that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And the key feature of how to do that right for Sartre

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: is to do it in the full recognition of the fact

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: that when you make that choice,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: nobody is responsible for it other than you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: So you don't make the choice because God tells you to,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: you don't make the choice because some utilitarian calculus

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: about what it's right to do tells you to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: You don't make the choice

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: because some other philosophical theory tells you to do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: There's literally nothing on the basis

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: of which you make the choice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Other than the fact that in that moment,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: you're the one making it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: You are a conscious thinking being that made a decision.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: So all of the questions about physics and free will

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: are out the window.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Yeah, that's right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: If you were a determinist about the mind,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: if you were a physicalist about the mind,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: if you thought there was nothing to your choices

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: other than the activity of the brain,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: other than the activity of the brain

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: that's governed by physical laws,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: then there's some sense in which it would seem at any rate

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: like you're not the ground of that choice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: The ground of that choice was the physical universe

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: and the laws that govern it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And then you'd have no responsibility.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And so Sartre's view is that the thing that's special

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: about us used to be special about God

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: is that we're responsible for becoming the being

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: that makes the choices that we do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And Sartre thinks that that's simultaneously empowering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: I mean, it practically puts us in the place of God

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: and also terrifying because what responsibility?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: How can you possibly take on that responsibility?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And he thinks it's worse than that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: He thinks that it's always happening.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Everything that you do is the result of some choice

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: that you've made, the posture that you sit in,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: the way you hold someone's gaze

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: when you're having a conversation with them or not,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: the choice to make a note when someone says something

body.input: or not make a note.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Everything that you do presents you as a being

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: who makes decisions and you're responsible for all of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: So it's constantly happening.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And furthermore, there's no fact about you

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: that you're independent of the choices

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: and actions you've performed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: So you don't get to say, Sartre's example,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: you're not a great writer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And so it's terrifying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: It puts a huge burden on us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And that's why Sartre says on his view of existentialism,

body.input: and our freedom consists in our ability

body.input: and our responsibility to make these choices

body.input: and to become someone through making them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And we can't get away from that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: But to him, it's terrifying not liberating

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: in the positive meaning of the word liberating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Well, so he thinks it should be liberating,

body.input: but he thinks that it takes a very courageous individual

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: to be liberated by it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: and sort of tradition.

body.input: But what's liberating about it, if it is,

body.input: is also terrifying because it means in a certain way,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: We couldn't choose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: If we were God and we existed outside of time, maybe,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: but we're not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: We're finite in the sense that we have a beginning

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: that we never chose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: We have an end that we're often trying to resist

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: or put off or something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And in between, there's a whole bunch of stuff

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: that organizes us without our ever having made the choice

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: and without the kind of being that could make the choice

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: to allow it to organize us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: We have a complicated relationship to that stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And I think we should talk about that at a certain point,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: but the first move is to say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Sartre's just got a sort of descriptive problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: He's missed this basic fact that there has to be

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: an awful lot about us that's settled

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: without our having made the choice to settle it that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Right, the thrownness of life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: That's a fundamental part of life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: You can't just escape it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: You can't escape it altogether.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Altogether.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Yeah, exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: You can't escape it altogether.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: But nevertheless, you are riding a wave

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: and you make a decision in the riding of the wave.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: You can't control the wave, but you should be like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: as you ride it, you should be making certain kinds

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: of decisions and take responsibility for it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: So why does this matter at all,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: the chain of decisions you make?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Good, well, because they constitute you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: They make you the person that you are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: So what's the opposite view?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: What's this view against?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: This view is against most of philosophy

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: from Plato forward.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Plato says in the Republic, it's a kind of myth,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: but he says people will understand their condition well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: If we tell them this myth, he says,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: look, when you're born, there's just a fact about you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Your soul is either gold, silver or bronze.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Those are the three kinds of people there are

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: and you're born that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And if your soul is gold, then we should identify that

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: and make you a philosopher king.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And if your soul is silver, well, you're not gonna be

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: a philosopher king, you're not capable of it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: but you could be a good warrior and we should make you that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And if your soul is bronze, then you should be a farmer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: laborer, something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And that's a fact about you that identifies you forever

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: and for always, independent of anything you do about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And so that's the alternative view.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And you could have modern versions of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: You could say the thing that identifies you is your IQ

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: or your genetic makeup or the percentage of fast switch

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: muscle fibers you've got or whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: It could be something totally independent of any choice

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: that you've made, independent of the kind of thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: about which you could make a choice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And it categorizes you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: It makes you the person that you are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: That's the thing that's art

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: and the existentialists are against.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: So this idea that something about you is forever limiting

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: the space of possible decisions you can make.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Sartre says, no, the space is unlimited.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Sartre is the philosopher of radical freedom.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Radical freedom.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Yeah, radical freedom.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And then you could have other existentialists who say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: look, we are free, but we gotta understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: the way in which our freedom is limited by certain aspects

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: of the kind of being that we are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: If we were radically free, we really would be like God

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: in the traditional medieval sense

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: and sort of these folks start with the idea that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: look, whatever we are, that's a kind of limit point

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: that we're not gonna reach.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: So what are the ways in which we're constrained

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: that that being the way the medievals understood him

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: wasn't constrained?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: So can you maybe comment on what is nihilism

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: and is it at all a useful other sort of group of ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: that you resist against in defining existentialism?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Yes, good, excellent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: So nihilism, the philosopher who made the term popular,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: although it was used before him as Nietzsche,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Nietzsche's writing in the end of the 19th century,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: in various places where he published things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: but largely in his unpublished works,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: he identifies the condition of the modern world

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: as nihilistic and that's a descriptive claim.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: He's looking around him, trying to figure out

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: what it's like to be us now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And he says it's a lot different from what it was like

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: to be human in 1300 or in the fifth century BCE.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: In 1300, like what people believed,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: the way they lived their lives was in the understanding

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: that to be human was to be created in the image

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: and likeness of God.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: That's the way they understood themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And also to be created sinful because of Adam and Eve's

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: transgression in the Garden of Eden

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: and to have the project of trying to understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: how as a sinful being, you could nevertheless

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: live a virtuous life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: How could you do that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And it had to do with for them getting in the right relation

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: to God.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Nietzsche says, that doesn't make sense to us anymore

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: in the end of the 19th century.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: God is dead, says Nietzsche famously.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And what does that mean?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Well, it means something like the role that God used to play

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: in our understanding of ourselves as a culture

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: isn't a role that God can play anymore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And so Nietzsche says, the role that God used to play

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: was the role of grounding our existence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: He was what it is in virtue of which we are who we are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And Nietzsche says, the idea that there is a being

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: that makes us what we are doesn't make sense anymore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: That's like Sartre's atheism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Sartre is taking that from Nietzsche.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And so the question is, what does ground our existence?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And the answer is nihil, nothing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And so nihilism is the idea that there's nothing

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: outside of us that grounds our existence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And then Nietzsche asked the question,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: well, what are we supposed to do about that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: How do we live?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And I think Nietzsche has a different story

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: than Sartre about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Nietzsche doesn't emphasize this notion of radical freedom.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Nietzsche emphasizes something else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: He says, we're artists of life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And artists are interesting because the natural way

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: of thinking about artists is that they're responding

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: to something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: They find themselves in a situation and they say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: this is what's gonna make sense of the situation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: This is what I have to write.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: This is the way I have to dance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: This is the way I've gotta play the music.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And Nietzsche says, we should live like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: There are constraints, but understanding what they are

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: is a complicated aspect of living itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And there's a great story, I think, from music

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: that maybe helps to understand this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: I think Nietzsche, of course, jazz didn't exist

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: when Nietzsche was writing, but I think Nietzsche

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: really is thinking of something like jazz improvisation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: I mean, he talks about improvisation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: There's classical improvisation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Nietzsche was, by the way, a musician.

body.input: But he was responding to that situation

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: It means without passions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And the Stoics, who you mentioned earlier,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: really thought that passions are what get in the way

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: of your living well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Because to live well, you have to think clearly

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: about what you should do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And you shouldn't let your resentments and your angers

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: and your petty animosities direct your behavior.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: You should release yourself from those kinds of passions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: So Stoicism, again, huge caricature,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: but it's an aim not to care because caring is bad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And there's certain forms of existentialism,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: certainly in Pascal and Kierkegaard and Dostoevsky

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: and Heidegger and Sartre in his own way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: So it's not just a theistic or atheistic thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: where what's crucial about us is that we do care.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Heidegger says, care is the being of Dasein.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Dasein is his name for us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: What it is to be us is to be the being that already cares.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And you can't not do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: You can pretend you're not doing it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: but you're just caring in a different way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: It's like Sartre saying,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: you can pretend you're not taking responsibility.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: You could pretend that you don't have to make a decision.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: That is making a decision.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: Not caring is a way of caring.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And so I think the existentialists that I'm interested in

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: think that we do care.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: That's constitutive of what it is to be us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And so they'll think that the Stoics got it wrong,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: but that leaves open a huge range of moves

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: about how we inhabit that existence well.

body.input: Let me ask about Ayn Rand.

body.input: Okay.

body.input: And there's a few conclusions.

body.input: and sort of a lot of people use that to dismiss her.

body.input: It's like, it's more like a Sartre thing.

body.input: Take responsibility for yourself,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

metadata.title: Podcast: Sean Kelly: Existentialism, Nihilism, and the Search for Meaning | Lex Fridman Podcast #227

body.input: And, but the reason I bring her up is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: I dream in shapes and forms and, you know, three-dimensional space with extreme detail

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: Or much more something, you know, different, either less abstract or more abstract

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: And with my team, we often create new words. I'm like, well, now we're going to call this the regulatory plexus of a gene

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: And that gives us now the language to sort of build on that as one concept that you then build upon with all kinds of other things

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: Now let's talk about language itself, words, sentences

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: This is a very distant construct from where language actually begun

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: So if you look at how we communicate, as I'm speaking, my eyes are shining and my face is changing through all kinds of emotions

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: And my entire body composition posture is reshaped and my intonation, the pauses that I make, the softer and the louder and the this and that are conveying so much more information

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: And if you look at early human language and if you look at how the great apes communicate with each other, there's a lot of grunting, there's a lot of posturing, there's a lot of emotions, there's a lot of sort of shrieking, etc

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: So I think of human communication as combining the ape component, but also of course the GPT-3 component

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: So basically there's the cognitive layer and the reasoning layer that we share with different parts of our relatives

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: And what I love about humanity is that we have both, we're not just a conversational system, we're a grunting, emotionally charged, weirdly interconnected system that also has the ability to reason

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: Now let's talk about Neuralink for a second

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: So what's the concept of Neuralink? The concept of Neuralink is that I'm going to take whatever knowledge is encoded in my brain directly transfer it into your brain

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: So this is a beautiful, fascinating and extremely sort of appealing concept, but I see a lot of challenges surrounding that

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: The first one is we have no idea how to even begin to understand how knowledge is encoded in a person's brain

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: I mean, I told you about this paper that we had recently with Li Hui Cai and Asaf Marco that basically was looking at these engrams that are formed with combinations of neurons that co-fire when a stimulus happens

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: Where we can go into a mouse and select those neurons that fire by marking them and then see what happens when they first fire and then select the neurons that fire again when the experience is repeated

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: These are the recall neurons and then there's the memory consolidation neurons

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: So we're starting to understand a little bit of sort of the distributed nature of knowledge encoding and experience encoding in the human brain and in the mouse brain

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: And the concept that we'll understand that sufficiently one day to be able to take a snapshot of what does that scene from Dave losing his mind, of Hal losing his mind and talking to Dave

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: You're the stars and the moon and the birds way up high. You're my evening sweet song, my morning blue sky.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: You are my muse, your spell has me caught. You bring me my voice and scatter my thoughts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: To put love in writing, in vain, I can try. But when I'm with you, my wings want to fly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: So I put down the pen and drop my defenses. Give myself to you and fill up my senses.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: The Baffled King composing HALU. That was beautiful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: What I love about it is that I did not bring up a dictionary of rhymes. I did not sort of work hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: So basically when I write poems, I just type. I never go back. I just...

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: So when my brain gets into that mode, it actually happens like I wrote it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: Oh, wow. So the rhymes just kind of... It's an emergent phenomenon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: It's an emergent phenomenon. I just get into that mode and then it comes out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: That's a beautiful one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: And it's basically... As you got it, it's basically saying it's no recipe and then I'm throwing the recipes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: And as I'm writing it, I'm like... So it's very introspective in this whole concept.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: So anyway, there's another one many years earlier that is darker.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: It's basically this whole concept of let's be friends. I was like, ugh.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: No let's be friends. Just like... So the last words are shout out, I love you or send me to hell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: So the title is Burn Me Tonight.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: Lie to me, baby. Lie to me now. Tell me you love me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: Break me a vow. Give me a sweet word, a promise, a kiss.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: Give me the world a sweet taste to miss. Don't let me lay here, inert, ugly, cold.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: With nothing sweet felt and nothing harsh told.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: Give me some hope, false foolish yet kind. Make me regret, I'll leave you behind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: Don't pity my soul or torture it right. Treat it with hatred. Start up a fight.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: For it's from mildness that my soul dies when you cover your passion in a bland friend's disguise.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: Kiss me now, baby. Show me your passion. Turn off the lights and rip off your fashion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: Give me my life's joy this one night. Burn all my matches for one blazing light.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: Don't think of tomorrow and let today fade. Don't try and protect me from love's cutting blade.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: Your razor will always rip off my veins. Don't spare me the passion to spare me the pains.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: Kiss me now, honey, or spit in my face. Throw me an insult I'll gladly embrace.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: Tell me now clearly that you never cared. Say it now loudly like you never dared.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: I'm ready to hear it. I'm ready to die. I'm ready to burn and start a new life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: I'm ready to face the rough burning truth rather than waste the rest of my youth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: So tell me, my lover, should I stay or go? The answer to love is one, yes or no.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: There's no I like you, no let's be friends. Shout out I love you or send me to hell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142

body.input: I don't think there's a better way to end a discussion of the meaning of life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Manolis Kellis: Meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything | Lex Fridman Podcast #142
