metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And then once it exists on paper, I think,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: well, why shouldn't I just build that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: There was an example where when realistic voice synthesis

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: first started in the 90s at Apple,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: where I worked in research, I was done by a friend of mine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I sort of sat down and started writing a poem,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: which each line I would enter into the voice synthesizer

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and see how it sounded and sort of wrote it for that voice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And at the time, the agents weren't very sophisticated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So they'd sort of add random intonation

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and I kind of made up the poem to sort of match

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: the tone of the voice and it sounded slightly sad

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and depressed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So I pretended it was a poem written

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: by an intelligent agent, sort of telling the user

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: to go home and leave them alone, but at the same time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: they were lonely and wanted to have company

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and learn from what the user was saying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And at the time, it was way beyond anything

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: that AI could possibly do, but since then,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: it's becoming more within the bounds of possibility.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And then at the same time, I had a project at home

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: where I did sort of a smart home.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: This was probably 93, 94, and I had the talking voice

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: who'd remind me when I walked in the door

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: of what things I had to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I had buttons on my washing machine

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: because I was a bachelor and I'd leave the clothes in there

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: for three days and they'd go moldy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So as I got up in the morning, it would say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: don't forget the washing and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I made photo albums that use light sensors

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: to know which page you were looking at,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: would send that over wireless radio to the agent

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: who would then play sounds that matched the image

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: you were looking at in the book.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So I was kind of in love with this idea of magical realism

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and whether it was possible to do that with technology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So that was a case where the sort of the agent

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: sort of intrigued me from a literary point of view

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and became a personality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I think more recently, I've also written plays

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and when plays you write dialogue

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and obviously you write a fixed set of dialogue

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: that follows a linear narrative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: But with modern agents as you design a personality

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: or a capability for conversation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: you're sort of thinking of,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I kind of have imaginary dialogue in my head

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and then I think, what would it take

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: not only to have that be real,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: but for it to really know what it's talking about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So it's easy to fall into the uncanny valley with AI

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: where it says something it doesn't really understand,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: but it sounds good to the person,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: but you rapidly realize that it's kind of just

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: stimulus response, it doesn't really have real world

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: knowledge about the thing it's describing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And so when you get to that point,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: it really needs to have multiple ways

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: of talking about the same concept.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So it sounds as though it really understands it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Now, what really understanding means

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: is in the eye of the beholder, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: But if it only has one way of referring to something,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: it feels like it's a canned response.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: But if it can reason about it

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: or you can go at it from multiple angles

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and give a similar kind of response that people would,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: then it starts to seem more like

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: there's something there that's sentient.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: You can say the same thing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: multiple things from different perspectives.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I mean, with the automatic image captioning

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: that I've seen the work that you're doing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: there's elements of that, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Being able to generate different kinds of statements.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Right, so in my team, there's a lot of work

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: on turning a medium from one form to another,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: whether it's auto-tagging imagery

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: or making up full sentences about what's in the image,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: then changing the sentence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: finding another image that matches the new sentence

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: or vice versa.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And in the modern world of GANs,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: you sort of give it a description

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and it synthesizes an asset that matches the description.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So I've sort of gone on a journey.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: My early days in my career were about 3D computer graphics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: the sort of pioneering work,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: sort of before movies had special effects

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: done with 3D graphics and sort of rode that revolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And that was very much like the Renaissance

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: where people would model light and color and shape

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And now we're kind of in another wave

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: where it's more impressionistic

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and it's sort of the idea of something

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: can be used to generate an image directly,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: which is sort of the new frontier

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: in computer image generation using AI algorithms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So the creative process is more in the space of ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: or becoming more in the space of ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: versus in the raw pixels.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Well, it's interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: It depends.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I think at Adobe, we really want to span the entire range

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: from really, really good,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: what you might call low-level tools by low-level,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: as close to say analog workflows as possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So what we do there is we make up systems

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: you can do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And that's really important for people

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: who want to create something really expressive

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: or really novel, because they have complete control.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And then a certain other tasks become automated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: It frees the artists up to focus on the inspiration

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and less of the perspiration.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So thinking about different ideas, obviously.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So that's one way in which we're trying to just make it

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So that there can be more of it, more demand,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: because it's less expensive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: or things which are non-confidential

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and in exchange for some benefit, tangible or otherwise,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I'm willing to share very fine-grained data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So another possible scenario is to capture relatively crude,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: high-level things from more people

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and then more detailed knowledge from people

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: who are willingly participate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: We do that today with explicit customer studies

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: where, you know, we go and visit somebody

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and ask them to try the tool

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and we human observe what they're doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: In the future, to be able to do that enough,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: to be able to train an algorithm,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: we'd need a more systematic process,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: but we'd have to do it very consciously

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: because one of the things people treasure about Adobe

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: is a sense of trust and we don't want to endanger that

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: through overly aggressive data collection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So we have a chief privacy officer

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and it's definitely front and center of thinking about AI

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: rather than an afterthought.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Well, when you start that program, sign me up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Okay, happy to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Is there other projects that you wanted to mention

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: that I didn't perhaps that pop into mind?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Well, you covered a number.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I think you mentioned Project Papatron.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I think that one is interesting because it's,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: you might think of Adobe as only thinking in 2D

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and that's a good example where we're actually

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: thinking more three-dimensionally

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: about how to assign features to faces

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: so that we can, if you take,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: so what Papatron does, it takes either a still

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: or a video of a person talking

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and then it can take a painting of somebody else

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and then apply the style of the painting

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: to the person who's talking in the video.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And it, unlike a sort of screen door post filter effect

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: that you sometimes see online,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: it really looks as though it's sort of somehow attached

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: or reflecting the motion of the face.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And so that's the case where even to do a 2D workflow

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: like stylization, you really need to infer more

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: about the 3D structure of the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And I think as 3D computer vision algorithms get better,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: initially they'll focus on particular domains like faces

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: where you have a lot of prior knowledge about structure

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and you can maybe have a,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: parameterized template that you fit to the image.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: But over time, this should be possible

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: for more general content.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And it might even be invisible to the user

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: that you're doing 3D reconstruction under the hood,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: but it might then let you do edits much more reliably

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: or correctly than you would otherwise.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And the face is a very important application, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So making things work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And a very sensitive,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: if you do something uncanny, it's very disturbing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: That's right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: You have to get it right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So in the space of augmented reality and virtual reality,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: what do you think is the role of AR and VR

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: in the content we consume as people, as consumers,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and the content we create as creators?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Now that's a great question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: We think about this a lot too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So I think VR and AR,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I think VR and AR serve slightly different purposes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So VR can really transport you to an entire immersive world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: no matter what your personal situation is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: To that extent, it's a bit like

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: a really, really wide screen television,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: where it sort of snaps you out of your context

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and puts you in a new one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And I think it's still evolving in terms of the hardware.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I actually worked on VR in the 90s,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: trying to solve the latency and sort of nausea problem,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: which we did, but it was very expensive and a bit early.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: There's a new wave of that now, I think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And increasingly, those devices are becoming all in one,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: rather than something that's tethered to a box.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I think the market seems to be bifurcating

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: into things for consumers

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and things for professional use cases,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: like for architects and people designing

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: where your product is a building,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and you really want to experience it better

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: than looking at a scale model or a drawing, I think,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: or even than a video.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So I think for that, where you need a sense of scale

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and spatial relationships, it's great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I think AR holds the promise of sort of taking

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: digital assets off the screen and putting them

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: in the context in the real world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: on the table in front of you, on the wall behind you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And that has the corresponding need

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: that the assets need to adapt to the physical context

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: in which they're being placed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I mean, it's a bit like having a live theater troupe

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: come to your house and put on Hamlet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: My mother had a friend who used to do this

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: at Stately Homes in England for the National Trust.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And they would adapt the scenes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and even they'd walk the audience through the rooms

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: to see the action based on the country house

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: they found themselves in for two days.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And I think AR will have the same issue

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: that if you have a tiny table in a big living room

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: or something, it'll try to figure out

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: what can you change and what's fixed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And there's a little bit of a tension between fidelity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: where if you captured, say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Nureyev doing a fantastic ballet,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: you'd want it to be sort of exactly reproduced,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and maybe all you could do is scale it down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Whereas somebody telling you a story

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: might be walking around the room doing some gestures,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and that could adapt to the room

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: in which they were telling the story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And do you think fidelity is that important in that space,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: or is it more about the storytelling?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I think it may depend on the characteristic of the media.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: If it's a famous celebrity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: then it may be that you want to catch every nuance,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and they don't want to be reanimated by some algorithm.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: It could be that if it's really, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: a lovable frog telling you a story,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and it's about a princess and a frog,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: then it doesn't matter if the frog moves in a different way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I think a lot of the ideas that have sort of grown up

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: in the game world will now come into

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: the broader commercial sphere once they're needing

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: adaptive characters in AR.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Are you thinking of engineering tools

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: that allow creators to create in the augmented world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: basically making a Photoshop for the augmented world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Well, we have shown a few demos

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: of sort of taking a Photoshop layer stack,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and then expanding it into 3D.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: That's actually been shown publicly as one example in AR.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Where we're particularly excited at the moment

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: is in 3D.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: 3D design is still a very challenging space,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and we believe that it's a worthwhile experiment

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: to try to figure out if AR or immersive

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: makes 3D design more spontaneous.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Can you give me an example of 3D design,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: just like applications?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Literally, a simple one would be laying out objects, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So on a conventional screen,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: you'd sort of have a plan view and a side view

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and a perspective view,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and you'd sort of be dragging it around with a mouse,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and if you're not careful,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: it would go through the wall and all that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Whereas if you were really laying out objects,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: say in a VR headset,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: you could literally move your head

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: to see a different viewpoint.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: They'd be in stereo, so you'd have a sense of depth,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: because you're already wearing the depth glasses, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So it would be those sort of big gross motor,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: move things around kind of skills

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: seem much more spontaneous,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: just like they are in the real world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: The frontier for us, I think,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: is whether that same medium can be used

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: to do fine-grained design tasks,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: like very accurate constraints on, say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: a CAD model or something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: That may be better done on a desktop,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: but it may just be a matter of inventing the right UI.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So we're hopeful that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: because there will be this potential explosion of demand

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: for 3D assets driven by AR

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and more real-time animation on conventional screens,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: that those tools will also help with,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: or those devices will help

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: with designing the content as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: You've mentioned quite a few interesting sort of new ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And at the same time, there's old-timers like me

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: that are stuck in their old ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I think I'm the old-timer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Okay, all right, all right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: But the opposed all-change at all costs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: When you're thinking about creating new interfaces,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: do you feel the burden of just this giant user base

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: that loves the current product?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And so anything new you do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: that any new idea comes at a cost that you'll be resisted?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Well, I think if you have to trade off control

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: for convenience, then our existing user base

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: would definitely be offended by that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I think if there are some things where you have

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: more convenience and just as much control,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: that may be more welcome.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: We do think about not breaking

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: well-known metaphors for things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So things should sort of make sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Photoshop has never been a static target.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: It's always been evolving and growing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And to some extent, there's been a lot of brilliant thought

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: along the way of how it works today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So we don't want to just throw all that out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: If there's a fundamental breakthrough,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: like a single click is good enough to select an object

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: rather than having to do lots of strokes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: that actually fits in quite nicely to the existing tool set,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So, it's sort of a virtuous cycle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And then the long-term legacy of a great research lab

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: hopefully will be not only the people who stay

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: but the ones who move through and then go off

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and carry that same model to other companies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And so, we believe strongly in industrial research

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and how it can complement academia

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and we hope that this model will continue to propagate

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and be invested in by other companies,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: which makes it harder for us to recruit, of course,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: but that's a sign of success.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And a rising tide lifts all ships in that sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And where's the idea born with the interns?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Is there brainstorming?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Is there discussions about, you know, like what?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Where do the ideas come from?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Yeah, as I'm asking the question,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I realize how dumb it is, but I'm hoping.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: No, it's not a dumb question at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: It's actually a question I asked.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I ask at the beginning of every summer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So, what will happen is we'll send out a call for interns.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: We'll have a number of resumes come in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: People will contact the candidates,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: talk to them about their interests.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: They'll usually try to find somebody

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: who has a reasonably good match

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: to what they're already doing

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: or just has a really interesting domain

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: that they've been pursuing in their PhD.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And we think we'd love to do one of those projects too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And then the intern stays in touch

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: with the mentor, as we call them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And then they come and at the end of two weeks,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: they have to decide.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So, they'll often have a general sense

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: by the time they arrive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And we'll have internal discussions

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: about what are all the general ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: that we're wanting to pursue

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: to see whether two people had the same idea

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and maybe they should talk and all that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: But then once the intern actually arrives,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: sometimes the idea goes linearly

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and sometimes it takes a giant left turn.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And we go, that sounded good,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: but when we thought about it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: there's this other project or it's already been done

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and we found this paper, we were scooped,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: but we have this other great idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So, it's pretty flexible at the beginning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: One of the questions for research labs is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: who's deciding what to do?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And then who's to blame if it goes wrong?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Who gets the credit if it goes right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And so, in Adobe, we push the needle very much

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: towards freedom of choice of projects

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: by the researchers and the interns,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: but then we reward people based on impact.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So, if the projects ultimately end up impacting the products

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and having papers and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And so, your alternative model just to be clear

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: is that you have one lab director who thinks he's a genius

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and tells everybody what to do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: takes all the credit if it goes well,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: blames everybody else if it goes badly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So, we don't want that model.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And this helps new ideas percolate up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: The art of running such a lab is that

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: there are strategic priorities for the company,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and there are areas where we do want to invest

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: in pressing problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And so, it's a little bit of a trickle down and filter up,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: meets in the middle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And so, you don't tell people you have to do X,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: but you say X would be particularly appreciated this year.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And then people reinterpret X through the filter

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: of things they want to do and they're interested in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And miraculously, it usually comes together very well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: One thing that really helps is Adobe has

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: a really broad portfolio of products.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So, if we have a good idea,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: there's usually a product team

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: that is intrigued or interested.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So, it means we don't have to qualify things

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: too much ahead of time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Once in a while, the product teams sponsor extra intern,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: because they have a particular problem

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: that they really care about,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: in which case it's a little bit more,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: we really need one of these.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And then we sort of say, great, I get an extra intern.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: We find an intern, he thinks that's a great problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: But that's not the typical model.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: That's sort of the icing on the cake,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: as far as the budget's concerned.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And all of the above end up being important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: It's really hard to predict at the beginning of the summer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: which we all have high hopes of all of the intern projects,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: but ultimately some of them pay off

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and some of them sort of are a nice paper,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: but don't turn into a feature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Others turn out not to be as novel as we thought,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: but they'd be a great feature, but not a paper.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And then others, we make a little bit of progress

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and we realize how much we don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And maybe we revisit that problem several years in a row

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: until it finally we have a breakthrough

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and then it becomes more on track to impact a product.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Jumping back to a big overall view of Adobe Research,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: what are you looking forward to in 2019 and beyond?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: What is, you mentioned there's a giant suite of products,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: giant suite of ideas, new interns,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: a large team of researchers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Where do you think, what do you think the future holds?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: In terms of the technological breakthroughs?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Technological breakthroughs, especially ones

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: that will make it into product,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: will get to impact the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So I think the creative or the analytics assistants

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: that we talked about where they're constantly trying

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: to figure out what you're trying to do

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and how can they be helpful and make useful suggestions

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: is a really hot topic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And it's very unpredictable as to when it'll be ready,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: but I'm really looking forward to seeing

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: how much progress we make against that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I think some of the core technologies

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: like generative adversarial networks

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: are immensely promising and seeing how quickly

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: those become practical for mainstream use cases

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: at high resolution with really good quality is also exciting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And they also have this sort of strange way

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: of even the things they do oddly are odd

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: in an interesting way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So it can look like dreaming or something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So that's fascinating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I think internally we have a Sensei platform,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: which is a way in which we're pooling our neural nets

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and other intelligence models into a central platform,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: which can then be leveraged

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: by multiple product teams at once.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So we're in the middle of transitioning from a,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: once you have a good idea,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: you pick a product team to work with

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and they sort of hand design it for that use case

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: to a more sort of Henry Ford,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: standard up in a standard way,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: which can be accessed in a standard way,

body.input: which should mean that the time between a good idea

body.input: and impacting our products will be greatly shortened.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And when one product has a good idea,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: many of the other products can just leverage it too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So it's sort of an economy of scale.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So that's more about the how than the what,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: but that combination of this sort of Renaissance in AI,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: there's a comparable one in graphics

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: with real-time retracing

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and other really exciting emerging technologies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And when these all come together,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: you'll sort of basically be dancing with light, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Where you'll have real-time shadows, reflections,

body.input: and as if it's a real world in front of you,

body.input: That's a really exciting future for creative,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: for myself too as a creator.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So first of all, I work at autonomous vehicles.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I'm a roboticist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I love robots.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: And I think you have a fascination with snakes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: both natural and artificial robots.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I share your fascination.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: I mean, their movement is beautiful, adaptable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: The adaptability is fascinating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: There are, I looked it up,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: 2,900 species of snakes in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: 375 randomness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Some are tiny, some are huge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Saw that there's one that's 25 feet in some cases.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So what's the most interesting thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: that you connect with in terms of snakes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Well, it actually came out of my work in the 80s

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: on computer animation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: where I started doing things like cloth simulation

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So I actually did a paper in 1988

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: called the Motion Dynamics of Snakes and Worms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: on both how snakes and worms move

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: and then did some of the early computer animation examples

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: So your interest in robotics came out of graphics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: Came out of simulation and graphics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: we actually did a movie called Her Majesty's Secret Serpent,

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: which tells you how old fashioned we were thinking back then.

metadata.title: Podcast: Gavin Miller: Adobe Research | Lex Fridman Podcast #23

body.input: kind of thing.
