metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: The following is a conversation with Todd Howard, one of the greatest video game designers

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: of all time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: He has led the development of the Fallout series and the Elder Scrolls series, including

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Arena, Daggerfall, Morrowind, Oblivion, Skyrim, and the future Elder Scrolls 6, and a totally

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: new world in an upcoming game called Starfield.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Many of these have won Game of the Year awards and have been some of the most celebrated

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: and impactful games ever made.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: To me, Skyrim is quite possibly the greatest game ever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: This is the Lex Friedman Podcast.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: To support it, please check out our sponsors in the description.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: And now, dear friends, here's Todd Howard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Is it possible that we are currently living inside a video game that the future you designed,

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: can you give hints as to how one would escape if this was a video game?

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: How can a video game character escape to outside the video game?

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Are these things you don't consider when you design the game?

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Actually we do, because in the kind of games that we make, we want it to be as open as

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: So when you start a game, you're always testing it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: What can I do?

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: What would the game allow me to do?

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: And you check everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: You try to pick up the mugs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: You try every door.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: You collide with everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Like, hey, what are the rules of this world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: We try to do games where we say yes as much as possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: That leads to some level of chaos.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: But if you were stuck in a video game, you would try everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: And usually you're going to find a door or a space where the designers didn't anticipate

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: you piling all those crates up and getting over a wall that they didn't expect.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: So it's not a designed doorway out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: It's an accidental, unintended doorway out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: And it's a happy bug.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: You could like Truman Show.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Just get in the ocean and go.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Just keep going.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Keep going.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: And then the ocean becomes the hardest to find that door.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: The bigger the world, the bigger the open world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: And then as we do it, we learn they're going to find a way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: So just don't try to pen them in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Usually we leave like this developer test cell area in the game that we don't anticipate

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: anyone will find.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: And they ultimately find it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: It usually has crates of all the weapons in the game and things like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: The little hints you drop now will just drive people mad, which is something I enjoy deeply.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: So Skyrim NPCs have at times hilarious dialogue.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: What does it take to build a good NPC dialogue?

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: The main thing is to make them reactive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: A lot of times when you write characters for movies or things like that, you want to make

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: that character interesting for themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: What's their story?

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: And there's some characters like that that the player definitely cares about, but the

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: best characters are the ones that react to you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: So you'll find a lot of people love our guards and the guards are written almost purely to

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: be reactive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Hey, nice tie.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: I like your jacket.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Do this cool watch.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: You know, hey, what'd you do?

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: And so that, hey, you're the man as you walk by.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: That makes them interesting or the way they react to something that you do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Lydia in Skyrim, who everybody loves, I'm sworn to carry your burdens.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: That's a generic line that all of the House Carls have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: And it just kind of lands when she says it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Why does it land?

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: And did you anticipate it would land?

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: There's a slight snarkiness in that particular read of it and you're asking her to do something

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: and she's reacting to you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: What about the trade off between maybe the randomness and the scripted nature of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: dialogue?

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Like, is there any room for randomness of the dialogue tree?

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Oh, absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: We tend to write them in stacks with, you know, it's a very small, think of it as a

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: small state machine that just says, okay, this is what's happening.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Here's a random list of things I could say to that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: And then some of that plays out in ways you don't anticipate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: But we look at the things, what are the players doing that we could have the characters respond

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: to that they don't expect, you know, jumping on tables or stealing stuff or, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: sneaking in in the middle of the night or those kinds of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: The more that we can do, the more reactive and interesting the characters appear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: And these state machines, how big are these things?

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Are these individual to the individual characters?

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: That's just fascinating how you design state machines.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Is it just a giant thing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: I would think of the AI as one big one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Oh, so for sort of everybody.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: So there's an AI.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: There's a manager for all the people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: And one of the things that people manager.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Right, right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Nice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: One of the things that makes what we do particularly unique is, and this is a trade off for what

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: people are seeing because a lot of it's not on the screen, but we're using cycles to run

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: this, which is we're thinking about everybody in the whole world all the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: The ones that are further away at a much less tick rate, they go into low, but we know if

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: they want to walk across the world and we're running every quest at the same time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Whereas in other open world games, you start an activity, the rest of the world is going

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: to shut down so that they can really make that as impactful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: I really prefer that the rest of it's going on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: It's more of a simulation that we're building.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: So when those things collide, that's where it gets the most interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: And so we're running all of those people and understanding where they want to go and their

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: cycles and what they want to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: And the ones that are closer to you, we just update a lot more.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: It's one way to think about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: I mean, that's really fascinating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: That's something that people had, they were wondering about to what degree it's possible

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: to run the world without you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: So there is a feeling to role playing games that you're the central, you're at the center

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: of the world and the whole world rotates around you as it does in normal life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Like when we walk around, there's a, when you forget yourself, you start to take yourself

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: very seriously.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Like you are the center of the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: You forget that there's 8 billion people on earth and you forget that they have lies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: That's actually a sobering realization that they all have really interesting life stories

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: and they have their worries.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: They suffer in different complicated ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: And yet when you play a role playing game, there's a, I mean, both computationally and

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: from a storytelling perspective, you wonder if the world goes on without you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: Like if you come back, if you take a break and you come back, is there still a bustling

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: town that now has a history since you have last visited?

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: So to what degree can you create a world that goes on without you or goes on at the same

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: time as you do your thing, whatever the heck you're doing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: We don't prioritize the stuff you can't see.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: So it's more like an amusement park.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: If you study like the design or level designers did this, how do they build Disney world in

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: these places?

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: It still exists for you, the player.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: So it is fairly, you know, when you're going to come in, this is what you're going to see.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: The shops are in the front.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: You're going to do this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: It's just for us to make it far more believable and get some more emergent behavior that not

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342

body.input: just make it sort of the verisimilitude of what you're in for that moment, but you buy

metadata.title: Podcast: Todd Howard: Skyrim, Elder Scrolls 6, Fallout, and Starfield | Lex Fridman Podcast #342
